raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Allow Anthropic `/v1/messages/count_tokens` to count prompts containing tools without requiring an output tool parser. Keep parser validation on generation requests.

## Claims

- Counting includes the rendered tool schemas instead of rejecting the request because generation parsing is disabled.
- `/v1/messages` retains its existing validation.

## Validation

Real Qwen3-0.6B HTTP before/fix/revert: counting with tools changes from HTTP 400 to HTTP 200 with 150 tokens, matching the tokenizer's rendered prompt. Plain counting remains 15 tokens and generation remains HTTP 400. The 108 conversion tests and the extended parser-validation test pass, as do applicable manual pre-commit hooks.

<details>
<summary>Reproduction and original results</summary>

Baseline `187a0eb98aa42341d703f83421d693fa7585581b`; candidate `9014097555`. One RTX 5090; Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130, Transformers 5.16.1.

Use model revision `c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca` and start the server without a tool parser:

```bash
hf download Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --revision c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca --local-dir model
vllm serve ./model --served-model-name qwen3 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18492 --max-model-len 512 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.3 --enforce-eager
```

Save as `repro.py`; run `.venv/bin/python repro.py 18492 qwen3`:

```python
import sys,time,json,requests
base=f'http://127.0.0.1:{sys.argv[1]}'
for _ in range(150):
 try:
  if requests.get(base+'/health',timeout=2).status_code==200:break
 except requests.RequestException:pass
 time.sleep(2)
else:raise RuntimeError('server did not start')
payload={'model':sys.argv[2],'messages':[{'role':'user','content':'What is the weather in Paris?'}]}
plain=requests.post(base+'/v1/messages/count_tokens',json=payload,timeout=30)
assert plain.status_code==200,plain.text
payload['tools']=[{'name':'get_weather','description':'Get weather','input_schema':{'type':'object','properties':{'city':{'type':'string'}},'required':['city']}}]
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
tokenizer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('./model')
tool=payload['tools'][0]
expected=len(tokenizer.apply_chat_template(payload['messages'],tools=[{'type':'function','function':{'name':tool['name'],'description':tool['description'],'parameters':tool['input_schema']}}],tokenize=True,add_generation_prompt=True,return_dict=False))
with_tools=requests.post(base+'/v1/messages/count_tokens',json=payload,timeout=30)
generate=requests.post(base+'/v1/messages',json={**payload,'max_tokens':4},timeout=30)
print(json.dumps({'expected_tools_count':expected,'plain_status':plain.status_code,'plain':plain.json(),'tools_status':with_tools.status_code,'tools':with_tools.json(),'generation_status':generate.status_code,'generation':generate.json()}),flush=True)
assert generate.status_code==400,'generation validation unexpectedly bypassed'
if with_tools.status_code==200:
 assert with_tools.json()['input_tokens']==expected,(with_tools.json(),expected)
 assert expected>plain.json()['input_tokens'],'tools missing from prompt'
 print('COUNT_TOOLS_PASSED')
else:
 assert with_tools.status_code==400 and 'tool' in with_tools.text
 print('COUNT_TOOLS_PARSER_REJECTED')
```

Original probe output (initialization omitted):

```text
baseline-r4
{"expected_tools_count": 150, "plain_status": 200, "plain": {"input_tokens": 15, "context_management": {"original_input_tokens": 15}}, "tools_status": 400, "tools": {"type": "error", "error": {"type": "BadRequestError", "message": "\"auto\" tool choice requires --enable-auto-tool-choice and --tool-call-parser to be set"}}, "generation_status": 400, "generation": {"type": "error", "error": {"type": "BadRequestError", "message": "\"auto\" tool choice requires --enable-auto-tool-choice and --tool-call-parser to be set"}}}
COUNT_TOOLS_PARSER_REJECTED

candidate
{"expected_tools_count": 150, "plain_status": 200, "plain": {"input_tokens": 15, "context_management": {"original_input_tokens": 15}}, "tools_status": 200, "tools": {"input_tokens": 150, "context_management": {"original_input_tokens": 150}}, "generation_status": 400, "generation": {"type": "error", "error": {"type": "BadRequestError", "message": "\"auto\" tool choice requires --enable-auto-tool-choice and --tool-call-parser to be set"}}}
COUNT_TOOLS_PASSED

revert
{"expected_tools_count": 150, "plain_status": 200, "plain": {"input_tokens": 15, "context_management": {"original_input_tokens": 15}}, "tools_status": 400, "tools": {"type": "error", "error": {"type": "BadRequestError", "message": "\"auto\" tool choice requires --enable-auto-tool-choice and --tool-call-parser to be set"}}, "generation_status": 400, "generation": {"type": "error", "error": {"type": "BadRequestError", "message": "\"auto\" tool choice requires --enable-auto-tool-choice and --tool-call-parser to be set"}}}
COUNT_TOOLS_PARSER_REJECTED
```

Targeted existing regression:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py -q -k test_tool_choice_validation_without_parser
```

</details>

## Details

Token counting needs tool-aware prompt rendering, but never parses generated output. Pass an internal keyword-only flag through the existing rendering path to skip only the output-parser availability check; its default remains enabled.

Duplicate check: #59718 validates tool choices after tool removal in the Anthropic conversion path. It does not remove the generation-parser requirement from token counting. #52896 implements a Rust frontend surface, not this Python renderer path.
